title: Sr. Analyst - Bangalore
description:
Job Description: Senior Business Analyst (Operations, Analytics \& Client Engagement)


Position Overview We are seeking an experienced, high\-caliber Senior Business Analyst with 6 to 9 years of experience to lead operational tracking, executive data analytics, and client engagement initiatives. In this role, you will serve as a strategic operational pillar—driving process governance, managing enterprise admin software stacks, and leveraging the Microsoft Office Suite to transform complex operational data into executive\-ready insights and high\-stakes presentations.

  

  

The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in advanced MS Excel architecture, master\-level PowerPoint storytelling, and proven leadership in managing high\-touch client interactions and cross\-functional team workflows.

  

  

Key Responsibilities


1\. Advanced Data Analytics \& Strategic Reporting (MS Excel \& Power Platform)


* Complex Data Architecture: Design, build, and maintain enterprise\-grade Excel models, automated performance dashboards, and data trackers using advanced functions (Index/Match, XLOOKUP, dynamic arrays, VBA/macros, and Power Query).
* Operational KPI Tracking: Monitor, analyze, and report on global practice performance, SLA compliance, utilization metrics, and financial/billing variances to drive executive decision\-making.
* Predictive \& Trend Analytics: Synthesize disparate datasets from multiple business systems into actionable trend analyses, identifying operational bottlenecks, risks, and efficiency opportunities.
  

  

2\. Executive Storytelling \& High\-Stakes Presentations (MS PowerPoint)


* C\-Suite \& Board Deliverables: Conceptualize, structure, and design polished, executive\-ready PowerPoint slide decks for Board meetings, Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), and strategic client proposals.
* Data Visualization \& Storytelling: Translate intricate technical data, operational workflows, and complex business metrics into clean, compelling visual narratives and executive summaries.
* Presentation Coaching: Partner with practice leaders to refine messaging, narrative flow, and visual alignment prior to major executive and external client briefings.
  

  

3\. Admin Software Governance \& Process Optimization


* Admin Stack Management: Oversee the daily administration, configuration, and user governance of internal enterprise software, CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce), and project tracking systems (e.g., Jira, Asana, ServiceNow).
* Workflow Automation: Leverage Microsoft 365 tools (Teams, SharePoint, Power Automate, Planner) to automate manual administrative tasks, approval chains, and document repositories.
* Tracking \& Operational Governance: Maintain end\-to\-end tracking systems for strategic practice initiatives, action logs, contract lifecycles, and cross\-team deliverables to ensure 100% accountability.
  

  

4\. Strategic Client Engagement \& Relationship Management


* Client Interface \& Account Governance: Act as a key operational liaison for client engagement activities—managing routine client communications, status reporting, and governance cadence.
* Meeting Orchestration: Lead pre\-meeting preparation, drive client\-facing status calls, document structured Minutes of Meeting (MOM), and rigorously enforce post\-meeting action item closure.
* Cross\-Functional Alignment: Collaborate with internal delivery leads, sales executives, and practice managers to ensure seamless execution of client commitments and rapid resolution of operational escalations.
  

  

Qualifications \& Skills


Technical Requirements


* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Finance, or a related field.
* Experience: 6 to 9 years of progressive experience as a Business Analyst, Senior Operations Analyst, or Client Engagement BA.
* MS Office Mastery: Expert\-level mastery of MS Excel (data modeling, macros, complex analytics) and MS PowerPoint (executive layout design, advanced formatting, storytelling).
* Software \& Systems Proficiency: Deep hands\-on experience with administrative software, project management/ticketing tools (Jira, ServiceNow, Trello), CRM systems, and MS Productivity Apps (Power Automate, Power BI, SharePoint).
* Data Synthesis \& Reporting: Advanced capability in raw data hygiene, quantitative analysis, process mapping, and executive metric reporting.
  

  

Soft Skills \& Work Environment


* Executive Presence \& Communication: Exceptional verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills with demonstrated poise when presenting to C\-suite leaders and key client stakeholders.
* Leadership \& Stakeholder Management: Proven ability to influence cross\-functional teams, manage client expectations under pressure, and mentor junior analysts.
* Meticulous Attention to Detail: Uncompromising standards for data accuracy, presentation formatting, and structured tracking across multi\-project environments.
* Adaptability \& Ownership: Proactive self\-starter capable of driving clarity in ambiguous environments and taking end\-to\-end ownership of complex assignments.
  

  

Preferred Certifications (Any of the following are a plus)


* Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP) / CCBA
* Microsoft Office Specialist (MOS) Expert (Excel / PowerPoint)
* PMI Professional in Business Analysis (PMI\-PBA) or PMP
* Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate / Power Platform Fundamentals

description:
Job Description – Senior Real Estate Sales Manager (Office Space Leasing)

Position: Senior Real Estate Sales Manager

Division: Office Space Leasing

Department: Sales / Business Development

Experience: 4–5 Years

Location: Bengaluru

Employment Type: Full\-Time

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced and result\-oriented Senior Real Estate Sales Manager to lead and drive business development for our Office Space Leasing Division.

The candidate will be responsible for generating new business, managing key client relationships, driving office space leasing transactions, handling negotiations, and achieving revenue targets. The role requires strong knowledge of the commercial real estate market, particularly office spaces, managed offices, coworking spaces, and commercial leasing.

The ideal candidate should be capable of independently managing high\-value client requirements from lead generation to transaction closure, while also supporting and guiding the sales team to achieve business targets.

Key Responsibilities

\* Business Development \& Sales

\* Drive new business acquisition for the Office Space Leasing Division.

\* Identify and develop new corporate, SME, startup, and business accounts requiring office spaces.

\* Generate leads through cold calling, networking, referrals, market visits, online platforms, and other business\-development channels.

\* Build and maintain a strong sales pipeline and ensure consistent movement of opportunities through the sales funnel.

\* Understand client requirements including location, seating capacity, budget, tenure, amenities, and business needs.

\* Recommend suitable office spaces, coworking spaces, managed offices, and commercial properties based on client requirements.

\* Conduct client meetings, property presentations, and site visits.

\* Independently manage the complete sales cycle from lead generation, requirement understanding, property options, site visits, negotiation, and closure.

\* Achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales and revenue targets.

Client \& Relationship Management

\* Develop and maintain strong relationships with corporate clients, decision\-makers, property owners, landlords, and workspace operators.

\* Act as the primary point of contact for key client accounts.

\* Understand client business requirements and provide customized office space solutions.

\* Maintain regular follow\-ups and ensure a high level of client engagement throughout the transaction.

\* Develop long\-term relationships to generate repeat business, referrals, and new opportunities.

Negotiation \& Deal Closure

\* Lead commercial negotiations with clients, landlords, and workspace providers.

\* Negotiate rental rates, lease terms, deposits, lock\-in periods, fit\-out requirements, and other commercial terms.

\* Prepare and present commercial proposals and property comparisons.

\* Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to resolve transaction\-related issues.

\* Drive negotiations effectively towards successful closure.

\* Ensure proper coordination for documentation, agreements, and transaction completion.

Team Management \& Sales Leadership

\* Guide and mentor Business Development Executives and Sales Associates within the leasing division.

\* Monitor individual and team performance against assigned targets.

\* Conduct regular pipeline reviews and provide guidance on active opportunities.

\* Support team members in client meetings, negotiations, and complex closures where required.

\* Identify gaps in the sales process and implement strategies to improve lead conversion and revenue generation.

\* Encourage a target\-driven and accountable sales culture.

Market \& Inventory Management

\* Maintain strong knowledge of the Bengaluru commercial real estate market.

\* Track rental rates, market trends, new developments, competitor activity, and workspace availability.

\* Build and maintain relationships with property owners, landlords, coworking operators, and managed office providers.

\* Identify new properties and opportunities that can strengthen the company's office\-space inventory.

\* Ensure accurate and updated property information is maintained in the CRM/inventory system.

CRM \& Reporting

\* Maintain accurate records of leads, client requirements, property options, site visits, proposals, negotiations, and closures.

\* Ensure timely updates of all sales activities in the CRM.

\* Prepare regular sales pipeline and performance reports for management.

\* Monitor conversion ratios and identify opportunities to improve sales performance.

\* Provide management with market feedback, sales insights, and business\-development opportunities.

Required Skills \& Qualifications

\* 4–5 years of experience in commercial real estate sales / office space leasing / coworking / managed office sales.

\* Proven track record of achieving sales and revenue targets.

\* Strong understanding of the Bengaluru commercial real estate market.

\* Experience handling corporate, SME, startup, and institutional clients.

\* Strong business development, lead generation, and client acquisition skills.

\* Excellent negotiation and closing abilities.

\* Strong communication and presentation skills.

\* Ability to independently manage high\-value sales transactions.

\* Leadership and team\-management capabilities.

\* Strong networking and relationship\-management skills.

\* Good understanding of commercial leasing terms and processes.

\* Experience working with CRM systems and sales reporting tools.

\* Willingness to travel for client meetings, market visits, and property inspections.

Pay: ₹1,000,000\.00 \- ₹1,500,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement

title: Solution Engineer Sales
description:
**About Unosecur**


Unosecur is a fast\-growing, Pre\-Series A startup with $5M in funding. We're a B2B security SaaS platform making identity security smarter and simpler for enterprises worldwide, with sales teams across the USA, Europe, and India.


You'll be part of a diverse team working on cybersecurity and AI, with opportunities to solve complex problems and build production\-grade AI capabilities.

**The Role**


We're hiring a Solution Engineer based in Bengaluru to provide technical presales support and drive Proof of Value / Proof of Concept engagements during the sales cycle, including with C\-level stakeholders. You'll partner closely with Account Executives to own the technical win in complex sales cycles.

**What You'll Do**

* Own the technical win. Partner with Account Executives and GTM to drive complex sales cycles from initial discovery to technical wins.
* Tailor the narrative. Translate complex technical identity risks into business value — explain an IAM policy misconfiguration to a DevOps Engineer, then explain the business impact of that risk to a CISO five minutes later.
* Execute high\-velocity PoVs. Run frictionless Proof of Values. Our technology connects via APIs and shows value in minutes — guide the customer through that data, highlighting critical identity risks (toxic combinations, shadow admins, over\-privileged roles) in their environment.
* Be a trusted advisor. Become a deep subject\-matter expert on Identity Security across cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP), identity providers (Okta, Entra ID), and business apps (Snowflake, GitHub) for clients and partners.
* Represent the voice of the customer. As an early member of the team, your feedback loop to Product and Engineering is critical — translate customer use cases and business requirements into clear feature requests to shape the roadmap.
* Evangelize. Represent Unosecur at industry conferences, webinars, and in technical blog posts.

**What You'll Need**

* 5\+ years of experience in Solution Engineering, Sales Engineering, or Technical Consulting within the SaaS or cybersecurity space
* Strong conceptual understanding of the major cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP) — how companies structure their cloud (organizations, projects, subscriptions) and the common security challenges they face
* Solid foundation in security concepts such as Identity and Access Management (IAM), Identity \& Access Governance (IAG), Privileged Access Management (PAM), Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM), Least Privilege, Zero Trust, and compliance standards
* Exceptional ability to present technical solutions to non\-technical audiences — can run a demo and handle objections with confidence
* Proven discovery skills: asking the right questions to uncover customer pain points and mapping them to technical solutions
* Startup agility: prior experience in early or growth\-stage startups, with a bias toward action and comfort with ambiguity

**Nice to Have**

* Experience selling or working with identity providers (Okta, Entra ID) and cloud security tools (Wiz, Prisma Cloud, Orca)
* Able to read and explain scripts as well as REST APIs
* Certifications such as AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner, Azure Fundamentals, or similar

title: Chief of Staff & Executive Assistant to Founder & CEO
description:
**Designation:** **Chief of Staff \& Executive Assistant to Founder \& CEO**
============================================================================

**Location:** Bengaluru, India — Hybrid / primarily office\-based
  

**Reports to:** Founder \& CEO
  

**Experience:** Ideally 6–10 years
  

**Employment Type:** Full\-time
  

**Working Hours:** India\-based role with **daily overlap with U.S. business hours,**

**This role is based in Bengaluru but is specifically designed to provide daily overlap with U.S. working hours.**

A typical work schedule is expected to be approximately:


**3:00/4:00 PM IST to 12:00/1:00 AM IST**

**About Organisation:**

We are a fast\-growing healthcare technology company building technology\-enabled virtual care solutions for specialty medical practices in the United States.


Our platform helps specialty practices deliver scalable care outside the clinic through virtual care programs, patient engagement, technology, clinical workflows and AI\-enabled solutions.


As our organisation continues to scale, we are looking for an exceptional **Chief of Staff \& Executive Assistant to the Founder \& CEO** , based in Bengaluru.


This is not a traditional Executive Assistant role.


The person will work closely with the Founder \& CEO across company strategy, leadership coordination, board preparation, customer initiatives, product priorities, hiring, business analysis and day\-to\-day CEO\-office operations.


The right person will become a trusted extension of the CEO.


**The Role**
============

The primary objective of this position is simple:


**Make the CEO and the organization significantly more effective.**

The role combines two responsibilities:


### **Executive Leverage**

Help the CEO manage time, information, communication, meetings, travel, priorities and follow\-through.


### **Chief of Staff / Business Execution**

Help translate CEO priorities into action across the company, coordinate senior leaders, drive strategic initiatives and prepare the CEO for important decisions.


Becauserimarily operates in the United States, this role will be based in Bengaluru but will operate substantially during overlapping U.S. business hours.


This is an important part of the position.


The person should expect to work with the CEO and U.S. leadership team **every working day** , rather than simply joining occasional evening calls.


**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**1\. Run the CEO Office**
--------------------------

Create a disciplined operating system around the CEO.


Maintain a clear view of:


* · CEO priorities
* · Key decisions
* · Delegated items
* · Follow\-ups
* · Important relationships
* · Upcoming meetings
* · Customer commitments
* · Board commitments
* · Strategic initiatives
* · Recruiting priorities
* · Important deadlines
* Nothing important should get lost.
* Proactively identify what requires the CEO’s attention rather than waiting for instructions.

**2\. Calendar \& Priority Management**
---------------------------------------

* Own and actively manage the CEO’s calendar.
* This is not simply a scheduling function.
* Understand:
* · Why a meeting is required
* · Whether the CEO needs to attend
* · Who else should participate
* · What decision is expected
* · Whether something can be delegated
* · Whether the issue can be handled asynchronously
* Protect the CEO’s time for the highest\-value activities.
* Coordinate meetings across U.S., India and international time zones.

Because this role works daily with the CEO during U.S. hours, the individual should be available to handle real\-time scheduling changes, priorities and issues during the CEO’s working day.


**3\. Daily CEO Coordination**
------------------------------

* Maintain a highly effective daily operating cadence with the CEO.
* This may include:
* · Reviewing priorities for the day
* · Preparing upcoming meetings
* · Identifying decisions required
* · Reviewing outstanding follow\-ups
* · Coordinating with senior executives
* · Tracking delegated actions
* · Surfacing issues requiring CEO intervention
* · Preparing information required for upcoming decisions
* The goal is to develop enough context that the individual increasingly anticipates what the CEO needs before being asked.

**4\. Meeting Preparation**
---------------------------

* Prepare the CEO for important:
* · Leadership meetings
* · Customer meetings
* · Board meetings
* · Investor discussions
* · Candidate interviews
* · Partnership discussions
* · Strategic planning sessions

For significant meetings, prepare concise briefing materials covering:


**Objective**  

Why are we having this meeting?


**Context**  

What does the CEO need to know?


**Decision**  

What decision or outcome is required?


**Issues**  

What are the unresolved questions or risks?


**Recommendation**  

What should we do?


The objective is for the CEO to enter important meetings already prepared.


**5\. Leadership Team Coordination**
------------------------------------

* Work closely with senior leaders across:
* · Product
* · Engineering
* · Finance
* · Sales
* · Operations
* · Clinical
* · Patient Engagement
* · Marketing
* · HR
* Track decisions and commitments made in leadership meetings.
* Follow up with owners.
* Ensure deadlines are met.
* Escalate issues when required.

The candidate must be comfortable following up with senior executives and holding people accountable while maintaining strong working relationships.


**6\. Strategic Projects**
--------------------------

* Take ownership of selected CEO\-led initiatives.
* Examples could include:
* · New product initiatives
* · Market expansion
* · Competitive analysis
* · Pricing strategy
* · Business model analysis
* · Strategic partnerships
* · M\&A opportunities
* · Customer initiatives
* · New business opportunities
* · AI initiatives
* · Organizational projects
* · Executive hiring
* · Operating\-plan initiatives

**8\. Board \& Investor Support**
---------------------------------

Support preparation for board meetings and investor discussions.


Responsibilities may include:


· Coordinating board materials


· Gathering functional updates


· Reviewing presentations


· Preparing CEO talking points


· Tracking board requests


· Managing follow\-ups

· Internal emails


· Leadership communications


· Customer communications


· Board communications


· Candidate outreach


· Investor communications


· Meeting summaries


· Presentations


Excellent written and spoken English is essential.

**10\. Travel \& Logistics**

Responsibilities may include:


· Flights


· Hotels


· Ground transportation


· Meeting logistics


· Itineraries


· Schedule coordination


· Last\-minute changes


Travel planning should optimize both business productivity and CEO time.


The individual may occasionally be required to travel within India or internationally.


This allows the individual to:


· Work with the CEO in real time


· Participate in leadership meetings


· Join important customer discussions


· Coordinate directly with U.S. executives


· Respond to issues during the U.S. business day


· Complete follow\-ups while U.S. teams are still online


This is **not an occasional late\-evening\-call requirement** .


Daily U.S. overlap is a normal and fundamental part of the position.


Candidates seeking a conventional 9 AM–6 PM India working schedule should not apply.


At the same time, we expect sustainable working hours. The position should not routinely require both a full Indian workday and a full U.S. workday.


**What We Are Looking For**
===========================

**Exceptional Organization**
----------------------------

You can manage dozens of concurrent priorities without losing track of details.


**Strong Business Judgment**
----------------------------

You understand what deserves CEO attention and what does not.


You know when to escalate, when to delegate and when to solve something yourself.


**Intellectual Curiosity**
--------------------------

You can quickly understand unfamiliar industries, technologies, financial concepts and business problems.


**High Ownership**
------------------

You naturally think:


**“How do I get this done?”**

rather than:


**“Whose responsibility is this?”**

**Bias Toward Action**
----------------------

You identify problems before they become urgent and proactively resolve them.


**Strong Analytical Ability**
-----------------------------

You are comfortable with numbers, spreadsheets, business metrics and structured problem solving.


**Excellent Communication**
---------------------------

You can communicate comfortably with:


· Senior executives


· Physicians


· Customers


· Investors


· Board members


· Employees


· External partners


**Persistence**
---------------

You are comfortable following up repeatedly when something needs to get completed.


**Low Ego**
-----------

You are equally comfortable preparing a strategic business analysis and fixing a calendar or travel issue.


Neither feels beneath you.


**Discretion**
--------------

You will have access to highly confidential business and personal information.


Trust and integrity are non\-negotiable.


**Ideal Background**
====================

We are deliberately flexible about exact background.


Strong candidates may come from:


· Chief of Staff roles


· Founder’s Office roles


· CEO Office roles


· Senior Executive Assistant roles


· Strategy and operations


· Management consulting


· Investment banking


· Startup operations


· Business operations


· Program management


We expect the strongest candidates to have approximately **6–10 years of professional experience** , although exceptional candidates outside this range will be considered.

An MBA is helpful but not required.


Experience working directly with **U.S.\-based executives or customers** is highly desirable.


Experience in healthcare, technology, SaaS, startups or U.S.\-focused businesses is useful but not mandatory.


**Important: This Is a Hybrid Role**
====================================

Candidates should clearly understand the nature of this position.


This is **not a pure strategy Chief of Staff role** .


And it is **not a traditional Executive Assistant role** .


**The ideal candidate enjoys both.**

title: Account Executive (SMB), Rippling Spend
description:
**About Rippling**
------------------


Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

  

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

  

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

  

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

  

The Spend Management Account Executive (SMB) role at Rippling provides an extremely unique opportunity \- we’re looking for talented and ambitious SMB Account Executives who can both manage a high velocity sales cycle while also implementing newly signed Rippling customers.

  

One fundamental belief at Rippling is that Account Executives should spend 100% of their time between engaging with interested prospects, managing sales cycles to help potential customers evaluate our product, closing revenue from marketing\-generated demos, driving Outbound activities to generate additional pipeline, and working with their customers to ensure a seamless transition to our platform.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Maintain a pipeline of high\-value prospects through salesforce to forecast revenue accurately
* Own the entire sales cycle from initial discovery and demo, to contract signature
* Reach out to prospective customers and create new Spend management Opportunities to Generate Pipeline Via Outbound.
* Consistently attain and overachieve quota on a monthly basis
* Become a product expert across our Spend Management platform and understand our competitor landscape
* Articulate Rippling’s Spend Management value proposition by using the appropriate sales qualification standards
* Work closely with your customers to ensure a smooth transition onto the Rippling platform

**What you will need**
----------------------

* Minimum 2 years of quota\-carrying experience in a full cycle closing role with strong prospecting, qualifying, negotiating, and closing skills
* Minimum 1 year experience selling to SMB/Mid\-market sized businesses
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced environment. AEs at Rippling close a large volume of deals every month and we require someone who is comfortable with volume and pace
* Proven track record of success (top 10% of sales org)
* Ability to discuss Rippling's value proposition with C\-level executives, finance teams, and decision makers
* Experience with outbound prospecting to our existing customer base and conducting product demonstrations
* High adaptability and understanding of change within the evolution of a startup

 **Please note:**

* This job requires you to work EST/EDT hours. (5:30pm to 2:30am IST)
* This is a hybrid role and will require you to work out our Bangalore office three days (Monday, Tuesday, Thursday) a week.

**Additional Information**
--------------------------


Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com

  

Rippling highly values having employees working in\-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office\-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

**Position:** Senior Real Estate Sales Manager  
**Division:** Office Space Leasing  
**Department:** Sales / Business Development  
**Experience:** 4–5 Years  
**Location:** Bengaluru  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

**Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced and result\-oriented **Senior Real Estate Sales Manager** to lead and drive business development for our **Office Space Leasing Division**.

The candidate will be responsible for generating new business, managing key client relationships, driving office space leasing transactions, handling negotiations, achieving revenue targets, and managing the sales team. The role requires strong knowledge of the commercial real estate market, particularly **office spaces, managed offices, coworking spaces, and commercial leasing**.

The ideal candidate should be capable of independently managing high\-value client requirements from **lead generation to transaction closure**, while also leading, supporting, and developing the sales team to achieve individual and business targets.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Business Development \& Sales**

* Drive new business acquisition for the **Office Space Leasing Division**.
* Identify and develop new corporate, SME, startup, and business accounts requiring office spaces.
* Generate leads through cold calling, networking, referrals, market visits, online platforms, and other business\-development channels.
* Build and maintain a strong sales pipeline and ensure consistent movement of opportunities through the sales funnel.
* Understand client requirements including location, seating capacity, budget, tenure, amenities, and business needs.
* Recommend suitable office spaces, coworking spaces, managed offices, and commercial properties based on client requirements.
* Conduct client meetings, property presentations, and site visits.
* Independently manage the complete sales cycle from **lead generation, requirement understanding, property options, site visits, negotiation, and closure**.
* Achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales and revenue targets.
* Support team members in generating new business and closing high\-value opportunities.

**Client \& Relationship Management**

* Develop and maintain strong relationships with corporate clients, decision\-makers, property owners, landlords, and workspace operators.
* Act as the primary point of contact for key client accounts.
* Understand client business requirements and provide customized office space solutions.
* Maintain regular follow\-ups and ensure a high level of client engagement throughout the transaction.
* Develop long\-term relationships to generate repeat business, referrals, and new opportunities.
* Guide team members in managing important client relationships and resolving escalated client concerns.

**Negotiation \& Deal Closure**

* Lead commercial negotiations with clients, landlords, and workspace providers.
* Negotiate rental rates, lease terms, deposits, lock\-in periods, fit\-out requirements, and other commercial terms.
* Prepare and present commercial proposals and property comparisons.
* Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to resolve transaction\-related issues.
* Drive negotiations effectively towards successful closure.
* Ensure proper coordination for documentation, agreements, and transaction completion.
* Review and support team\-led negotiations to improve closure rates and commercial outcomes.

**Team Management \& Sales Leadership**

* Manage, lead, and motivate Business Development Executives, Sales Associates, and other team members within the leasing division.

title: VP, Investment Allocations
description:
Blackstone is the world’s largest alternative asset manager. Blackstone seeks to deliver compelling returns for institutional and individual investors by strengthening the companies in which the firm invests. Blackstone’s over $1\.3 trillion in assets under management include global investment strategies focused on real estate, private equity, credit, infrastructure, life sciences, growth equity, secondaries and hedge funds. Further information is available at www.blackstone.com. Follow @blackstone on LinkedIn, X (Twitter), and Instagram.

**Job Summary and Business Unit Overview**


Blackstone Credit \& Insurance (BXCI) was created in September 2023 by combining Blackstone's Credit and Insurance businesses. BXCI offers a broad range of solutions across corporate and asset\-based credit, including investment\-grade and non\-investment\-grade private credit. BXCI invests across the credit markets and manages strategies focused on sectors with strong fundamentals.


We are seeking a highly motivated Vice President to lead the Investment Allocations team within BXCI. The role will oversee the Bengaluru Center of Excellence (CoE) team and partner closely with global Investment Allocations stakeholders. The Vice President will be responsible for allocation governance, operational execution, controls, data quality, team leadership, and strategic transformation. The role requires sound judgment, strong execution discipline, and the ability to communicate effectively with senior stakeholders across Investments, Capital Formation, Insurance, Finance, Operations, Technology, Legal and Compliance, and Data teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the Bengaluru Investment Allocations CoE and establish clear objectives, service standards, capacity plans, and accountability across the team.
* Partner with global colleagues to run hypothetical allocation scenarios (hypos), evaluate allocation outcomes, and support the timely and accurate finalization of allocations across asset classes, funds, and client mandates.
* Oversee the end\-to\-end allocation process, including data intake, eligibility validation, constraint monitoring, exception management, approvals, booking support, and post\-allocation review.
* Ensure allocations are executed in accordance with approved policies, investment guidelines, client and fund restrictions, conflicts protocols, and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Establish and maintain robust governance, including maker\-checker controls, documented approvals, audit trails, escalation protocols, and periodic control attestations.
* Define, monitor, and report key risk indicators (KRIs), key performance indicators (KPIs), service\-level metrics, and operational trends; drive timely remediation of identified issues.
* Perform and oversee periodic allocation surveillance, portfolio reviews, and management reporting for relevant business and client stakeholders.
* Drive consistent data quality and reconcile allocation inputs and outputs across source systems, models, and downstream records; ensure exceptions are investigated and resolved promptly.
* Act as the senior point of contact across business, Technology, Finance, Operations, Data, Legal and Compliance, Capital Formation, and Insurance teams globally.
* Lead strategic initiatives focused on modernization, workflow digitization, automation, standardization, and operational scalability.
* Assess change impacts, define business requirements, coordinate user acceptance testing, and ensure effective implementation and post\-go\-live stabilization of new processes and systems.
* Create effective handover and follow\-the\-sun operating models between regional teams, supported by clear procedures, business continuity plans, and cross\-training.
* Build, coach, and retain a high\-performing team through structured development plans, timely feedback, succession planning, and an inclusive culture of ownership and continuous improvement.
* Prepare concise, executive\-level updates on performance, capacity, risks, issues, dependencies, decisions, and strategic outcomes.
* Respond to ad hoc requests from Investment, Capital Formation, Insurance, and other stakeholders, providing accurate and timely analysis.
* Support internal and external audits, regulatory inquiries, and risk or compliance reviews by maintaining complete and readily retrievable evidence.


Required Skills and Competencies

* Strong knowledge of investment allocation processes, portfolio management operations, private credit, fund structures, and investment guideline monitoring.
* Demonstrated people leadership experience, including managing managers or senior individual contributors in a global or CoE operating model.
* Strong control mindset with experience in operational risk, governance, issue management, root\-cause analysis, and remediation.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex data, identify patterns, and make sound decisions under time pressure.
* Ability to understand the broader business context while maintaining close attention to detail and accuracy.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to influence senior stakeholders and communicate complex matters succinctly.
* Proven ability to manage competing priorities, multiple projects, and demanding deadlines with limited guidance.
* Strong relationship\-building skills and the ability to work seamlessly across functions and geographical locations.
* Experience driving process optimization, automation, technology implementation, and data\-driven decision\-making.
* High standards of integrity, accountability, professional judgment, and commitment to excellence.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly advanced Excel and PowerPoint; familiarity with data visualization, workflow, or analytics tools is preferred.


Qualifications and Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Business, or a related discipline. A Chartered Accountant qualification, CFA, CPA, or MBA in Finance is preferred.
* 10 \+ years of relevant experience in investment management, private credit, asset management operations, a Big Four firm, or a global financial services organization.
* Prior experience in investment allocations, portfolio operations, guideline monitoring, or a related investment control function is strongly preferred.
* Knowledge of direct lending, private credit, insurance mandates, and multi\-fund allocation frameworks is advantageous.
* Experience leading a distributed team and partnering with stakeholders in North America or other global locations is preferred.

Salesforce data model familiarity.

* Comfort working with messy source data and reconciliation logic.

* Strong communication skills and an eye for executive\-level visual storytelling.
* Ability to build quickly without overengineering.

* Deep curiosity about AI tools, systems, and applied workflows.  

  

Preferred Experience

* Familiarity with event data, product telemetry, and usage analytics.
* Experience in fast\-moving AI, infrastructure, or SaaS environments.

**Role : SME Sales Executive**

**Location :** MG Road, Bangalore (In\-House)  
**Reporting to :** SME Sales Lead (UK) / SME Sales Shift Lead  
**Markets Covered:** US\-Canada  
**Tools Used :** Zendesk (calls, tickets), Calendly, Company Platform

**About the** Company is an online services marketplace connecting customers with professionals across over 1,000 categories. Operating in nine countries including the UK, US, Australia, Canada, and New Zealand, we're transforming how people find trusted service providers for everything from home improvement to professional services.  
Our platform uses cutting\-edge technology to match customers with the right professionals quickly and efficiently. We're currently undergoing an exciting transformation: migrating from a lead generation model to a full marketplace platform with subscription\-based pricing.  
As a profitable, PE backed scale up (EMK Capital), Company offers the best of both worlds: the agility and innovation of a fast\-moving business combined with financial stability and resources for growth. We recently launched our new marketplace model in Australia (Q4 2025\) and are preparing for rollout to the UK and US markets in 2026\. You'll have genuine ownership, responsibility, and the opportunity to shape our commercial strategy during a pivotal transformation phase with the chance to make your own contribution to our journey.

**Role Overview**

The **SME Sales Executive** is a front\-line sales role responsible for engaging small and medium\-sized businesses (SMEs) who have shown interest in Company’s platform. This role combines **outbound cold calling**, **live selling and activation**, and **onboarding conversations** to help sellers start winning work through Company.

Sales Executives will speak to business owners across global English\-speaking markets, build trust quickly, clearly explain Company’s value, and guide sellers toward either booking an onboarding session or activating directly on the call.

This role requires confidence on the phone, strong communication skills, resilience, and the ability to follow structured sales processes while delivering a high\-quality seller experience.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Outbound Sales \& Cold Calling**

· Make high\-volume outbound calls to sellers using Zendesk

· Engage new and lapsed sellers through structured cold\-calling frameworks

· Confidently explain Company’s value proposition (for both lead\-gen and marketplace model)

· Handle common objections and move conversations forward.

· Determine whether the best next step is:

o Booking an onboarding meeting, or

o Activating and selling on the call

**Meeting Booking \& Scheduling**

· Book onboarding or follow\-up meetings using Calendly.

· Guide sellers through availability using simple, conversational questions:

o “Which day works best for you?”

o “Morning or afternoon?”

· Confirm meeting details clearly and professionally.

· Send follow\-up emails with Calendly links when sellers cannot commit immediately.

**Live Selling \& Seller Activation**

· Activate sellers directly on a call or during pre\-booked activation calls.

· Explain pricing, credits, lead flow, and value clearly and confidently.

· Help sellers select the right categories, locations, and lead settings.

· Ensure sellers understand best practices before purchasing leads.

· Maintain compliance with approved scripts, pricing, and offers.

**Onboarding Calls**

· Conduct onboarding calls with sellers who have already booked meetings.

· Walk sellers through:

o Activation and start pack options (if required)

o Profile setup

o Lead settings and filters

o Buying and responding to leads

o Best practices to maximise conversion

· Answer questions and remove friction during early platform usage.

· Deliver a positive, consultative seller experience.

**Systems, Process \& Data Accuracy**

· Accurately log all call outcomes, notes, and actions in Zendesk.

· Use correct dispositions for unanswered calls, voicemails, callbacks, and meetings booked.

· Follow outbound cadence rules (call attempts, voicemail, email follow\-ups).

· Adhere to compliance, quality, and communication standards.

**Key Skills \& Experience**

· 1–3 years’ experience in outbound sales, inside sales or customer support.

· Comfortable making cold calls to business owners and decision\-makers.

· Clear, neutral, and confident spoken English suitable for global markets.

· Strong objection\-handling and conversational selling skills.

· Ability to follow structured scripts while sounding natural and authentic.

· Comfortable using CRM or ticketing tools (Zendesk experience is a plus).

· Resilient, target\-driven, and comfortable handling rejection.

· Willingness to work aligned to US/UK business hours.

**Working Hours \& Availability**

· If supporting US\-Canada \- Shift 08:00 PM IST to 05:00AM IST

· If supporting UK\-Ireland \- Shift 12:30PM IST to 09:30PM IST

· If supporting Australia\-New Zealand \- Shift 05:00AM IST to 02:00PM IST  
**Perks and Benefits**

· Flexible working policy with India office located in CBD Bangalore

· Insurances \- Family Floater Mediclaim, Employee Personal Accident and Employee Term Life

· Personal annual L\&D Budgets to spend on your development

· **Cult.fit** membership for all employees with access to mental health courses and fitness classes

· Fully stocked snacks in pantry, Quarterly All\-site Socials

· Being at the forefront of an industry with new and exciting problems to solve

**Interview Process**

· Screening with Talent Partner

· 1st Stage \- Interview with Hiring Manager (30 mins)

· 2nd Stage \- Technical Task \& Interview (60 mins

3rd Stage \- Values interview (30 mins)

description:

**General Summary:**

As a leading technology innovator, Qualcomm pushes the boundaries of what's possible to enable next generation experiences and drives digital transformation to help create a smarter, connected future for all. As an **ASIC Design Manager** **(** **Principal** **/ Director\-Le** **vel)** in the **Custom Silicon Group** , you will lead the development and delivery of next\-generation, high\-performance SoCs from concept to tapeout. You will be responsible for driving the complete silicon development lifecycle, spanning architecture, RTL design, integration, physical design, verification, silicon bring\-up, and production readiness. In addition to providing technical and organizational leadership, you will serve as a key customer\-facing engineering leader, partnering with strategic customers and stakeholders to translate business requirements into successful silicon solutions.


You will lead a team of engineers and work closely with cross\-functional groups across geographies \- including RTL design, verification, CAD, and integration teams. Your role will be pivotal in shaping the physical design strategy, ensuring design convergence, and maintaining signoff integrity across timing, power, and area metrics.


**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 8\+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience.

OR
  

Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 7\+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience.
  

OR
  

PhD in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 6\+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience.
**Principal Duties and responsibilities:**

* Demonstrate proven experience in executing responsibilities across multiple sites.
* Lead and manage a team across multiple functions.
* Design closure and tapeout expertise in advanced technology nodes.
* Complete ownership of PnR implementation, including Floor planning, Placement, CTS, and post\-route activities on the cutting\-edge nodes.
* Possess mandatory signoff knowledge, including STA, Power Analysis, FV, Low Power Verification and PV.
* Collaborate effectively to resolve issues related to constraints validation, verification, STA, Physical Design and tapeout
* Understand deep sub\-micron design challenges, including leakage power, signal integrity, and DFM.
* Support pre\-sales and business development activities by evaluating technical feasibility and providing design expertise.
* Provide technical leadership during design reviews and executive\-level customer engagements.
* Drive resolution of customer\-reported issues by coordinating across design, verification, firmware, software, and validation teams.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Excellent hands\-on experience on Floor planning, PnR and STA flows
* Good knowledge of Placement/Clock Tree Synthesis (CTS), Low Power/High Performance optimization etc.
* Thorough understanding of signoff domains– LEC/CLP/PDN etc.
* 18\+ years of experience with Physical Design and timing signoff expertise in latest tech nodes (e.g., 2nm/3nm/4nm/5nm)

title: Technical Account Manager
description:
**About Hevo**
--------------



DoorDash, Footlocker, Arhaus, Santander, and thousands of other data\-driven companies have one thing in common. They all use Hevo Data’s fully managed Automated Pipelines to consolidate their data from multiple sources like Databases, Marketing Applications, Cloud Storage, SDKs, Streaming Services, etc.



We are a San Francisco, Bangalore, and Pune\-based company with 2000\+ customers spread across 45\+ countries in e\-commerce, financial technology, and healthcare. Strongly backed by marquee investors like Sequoia Capital, we have raised $42 Million to date and are looking forward to our next phase of hyper\-growth!


**Why do we exist?**



At Hevo, our mission is to enable every company to be data\-driven. We started on this journey 9 years back, and as the first step in this direction, we built our first product – “Data Pipeline” or simply “Pipeline”.



Hevo Pipeline is a no\-code platform that helps companies connect all their sources of data within the company to get a unified view of their business. The platform offers integrations with 150\+ data sources such as Databases, SaaS applications, Advertising Channels, etc.



Today, we enable close to 2000 companies across more than 40\+ countries to be more data\-driven. Our aim is to make the technology so simple that anyone should be able to solve their data problems and not be limited due to their lack of technical skills.


**The Role**
------------



We are growing into mid\-market and enterprise accounts where the technical bar \- and the stakes \- are higher. To win and retain these customers, we are building the technical depth in our post\-sale motion to match.



Enterprise buyers are not just buying a product. They are making architectural decisions. The CTOs, data architects, and engineering leads we work with at this level need a technical counterpart.



As a Solution Engineer, you are that person. You are not the first point of contact, and you are not handling tickets.



You are the expert our Account Managers bring in when a customer conversation goes beyond relationship management \- a quarterly architecture review, a complex integration challenge, a strategic expansion decision, or simply when a CTO wants to talk to someone who really knows data.


**What You Will Do**
--------------------


* Be the senior technical specialist that Account Managers call on for complex customer conversations \- architecture reviews, expansion discussions, and senior\-level technical engagements.
* Engage credibly with CTOs, senior engineers, and data architects as a genuine thought partner: understand their architecture, challenge assumptions, co\-design pipelines, and offer a credible point of view.
* Lead technical discovery and solution design for enterprise customers evaluating new use cases, migrations, or architectural changes involving Hevo.
* Translate complex customer requirements into actionable guidance \- both for the customer and, where needed, and for Hevo's internal engineering team.
* Build and maintain deep expertise in the modern data stack: cloud data warehouses, orchestration, transformation, and the broader ecosystem Hevo operates within.
* Identify expansion opportunities through technical engagement and hand them off to the AM with enough context to move the conversation forward commercially.
* Contribute to internal knowledge \- documenting patterns, building reference architectures, and raising the technical bar across the post\-sales team.

**What We Are Looking For**
---------------------------


**Required**


* 6\+ years of experience in a technical, customer\-facing role \- Solutions Engineering, Data Engineering, or a technical post\-sale or consulting function.
* Deep, broad knowledge of data engineering: ETL/ELT pipelines, cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks), orchestration, and the modern data stack.
* Hands\-on experience with data integration tools, CDC, event streaming, or warehouse\-native transformation (dbt, etc.).
* Demonstrable ability to engage at the architectural level \- not just explain a product, but understand and speak to a customer's data infrastructure.
* Strong communication skills: you can make complex technical ideas clear to both engineers and executives, and you are confident pushing back when a customer's approach is suboptimal.
* Comfort working in an ambiguous, fast\-moving environment with a small team and high autonomy.

**Nice to Have**


* Experience in a pre\-sales or post\-sales SE role at a data infrastructure or SaaS company.
* Exposure to enterprise data governance, compliance, or security requirements (SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA).
* Prior experience in a startup or high\-growth B2B SaaS environment.

**What You Will Not Be Doing**
------------------------------



This is not a support role, a ticket\-handling role, or a general customer success role. You will not be measured on ticket volume or response SLAs. You will be measured on whether enterprise customers trust Hevo at the technical level \- and whether that trust translates into deeper, longer, larger relationships.


**What We Offer**
-----------------


* Competitive compensation and/or equity.
* Direct access to leadership and real influence on how the post\-sale function is built.
* A collaborative, high\-trust environment where technical depth is valued and rewarded.
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Senior Enterprise Business Development Manager - APAC
description:
**About Innovatrics**


Innovatrics is a global provider of biometric identity management solutions, delivering fingerprint, face, iris, and multimodal biometric technologies to government and enterprise customers worldwide. The company operates independently with a strong R\&D foundation and a reputation for high NIST\-ranked performance and scalable identity platforms.

**Your Role**


As a Senior Enterprise Business Development Manager for APAC, you will be responsible for building Innovatrics’ enterprise footprint across the region from the ground up.


Unlike mature markets, APAC represents a high\-potential, underpenetrated territory where brand awareness and customer references are still limited. This role is focused on proactive market creation, new logo acquisition, and strategic expansion across key enterprise verticals including financial services, fintech platforms, telecom operators, digital marketplaces, and OEMs.


You will act as a market builder — identifying opportunities, structuring entry strategies, and converting early wins into long\-term regional growth engines.


In a nutshell, you will have to:

* Drive aggressive new business acquisition across APAC.
* Establish anchor enterprise references in priority countries.
* Build structured pipeline from outbound prospecting and ecosystem leverage.
* Develop positioning for identity verification, fraud prevention, and biometric onboarding use cases.
* Develop the region into a scalable revenue contributor over 3–5 years.

  

This is a high\-impact, high\-ownership hunter role — not an account maintenance position.

**Geographic Scope**

* APAC


Travel: 40–60% depending on active programs.

 **Why This Job Is Exciting**


This is a strategic expansion role with full ownership of Innovatrics’ enterprise growth across APAC.


You will lead market creation in a region where digital identity, onboarding, and fraud prevention are accelerating — yet where we are still building our footprint.


Success in this role means transforming a greenfield opportunity into a structured, reference\-backed regional business — with strong executive exposure and long\-term scaling potential.

 **Within one month, you will:**

* Get fully on\-boarded with our Enterprise solutions, platforms, and key tools
* Start building relationships with internal teams—Sales, Solutions, Engineering and Professional Services
* Learn our key customer use cases and industry challenges
* Learn our CRM (Zoho), automation tools, and account segmentation model
* Shadow sales calls and client meetings to understand our approach and customer profiles
* Take ownership of a portfolio of early\-stage enterprise accounts

 **Within three months, you will:**

* Complete a structured market assessment across priority countries (South\-East Asia).
* Define country prioritization and vertical focus (banks, fintech, telcos, digital platforms).
* Map top 30–50 target enterprise accounts.
* Initiate outbound engagement with decision\-makers.
* Align internally with Presales and Product on competitive positioning for LATAM.
* Deliver a 12\-month regional action plan.

 **Within six months, you will:**

* Build a qualified pipeline with clear revenue visibility.
* Conduct executive\-level meetings with key target accounts.
* Advance at least one lighthouse opportunity to late\-stage negotiation.
* Formalize at least one regional ecosystem partnership (SI, fintech integrator, or technology ally).
* Adapt messaging to regional regulatory and fraud landscape specifics.
* Deliver reliable forecast visibility to leadership.

 **Within one year, you will:**

* Secure at least one anchor enterprise customer and build a multi\-quarter pipeline with 3x coverage.
* Establish at least one referenceable customer.
* Demonstrate repeatable outbound motion across at least two priority countries.
* Create structured local case narratives for marketing leverage.
* Build a sustainable pipeline with multi\-quarter coverage.

**About You**


You have repeatedly built enterprise markets from limited brand presence to structured revenue engines. You thrive in greenfield territories where brand awareness is still being built and where success depends on initiative, structure, and persistence.


You understand how to engage C\-level executives, navigate complex enterprise decision cycles, and position high\-impact digital solutions in a way that resonates with business, risk, and technology stakeholders alike.


You are proactive and self\-driven. You do not wait for inbound leads — you create opportunities. You are comfortable building pipeline from scratch, qualifying rigorously, and focusing energy where probability of impact is highest.


You are comfortable competing against well\-established global and regional players and differentiating through technical performance and business value.


You combine strategic thinking with execution discipline. You can define a country entry strategy and, in the same week, lead a negotiation with a priority account.


You operate with autonomy, resilience, and accountability — and you are motivated by building something meaningful, not simply managing an existing book of business.

 **Requirements** **Qualifications**

* University degree in Technology, Engineering, or Business
* 10\+ years of enterprise sales experience in APAC.
* Proven hunter track record in new logo acquisition.
* Experience selling SaaS, identity verification, cybersecurity, or mission\-critical digital solutions.
* Existing network in Identity Industry is desired
* Strong understanding of APAC regulatory and compliance environments.
* Executive presence and negotiation maturity.
* Fluent in English.
* Comfortable working in hybrid/remote setups

  

**Benefits**  

  

Compensation
At Innovatrics, we offer highly competitive salaries because we value top talent focused on creating meaningful impact. Compensation is based on your experience, skills, qualifications, and location.


Compensation will be determined based on your expertise and the value you bring to our network.


This is a high\-impact, high\-ownership role combining market development, partner acquisition, and long\-term revenue growth.


Beyond base pay, we provide an attractive benefits package. You can learn more at https://careers.innovatrics.com/


**Interview Process**
Here is the typical interview process for this role:


Recruiter Screen (30 min)


Hiring Manager Interview (45 min)


Team Interview: Practical Business Case focused on Account Acquisition (60 min)


CARES (30 min)


Reference checks and offer discussion

description:
About the Role

We are looking for a **Business Development Executive – SFO (Small Fleet Operator) Program** to build and scale our network of small fleet operators in Bangalore.

The role will be responsible for identifying fleet owners and vehicle operators, pitching our vehicle rental/fleet program, negotiating commercials, onboarding vehicles in bulk, and ensuring successful activation and utilization of the fleet.

This is a **highly field\-oriented, target\-driven role** and is best suited for someone who has worked with **fleet owners, transporters, EV operators, logistics partners, 3PLs, delivery partners or vehicle rental/leasing businesses**.

Key Responsibilities1\. Fleet Owner Acquisition

* Identify and build a strong pipeline of **Small Fleet Operators (SFOs), fleet owners, transporters and vehicle aggregators** across Bangalore.
* Develop relationships with owners operating multiple 2W, 3W, 4W or commercial vehicles.
* Generate leads through field visits, referrals, industry networks, market mapping, cold calling and local partnerships.
* Identify high\-potential fleet clusters and micro\-markets for targeted acquisition.
* Conduct regular field visits to fleet yards, transport hubs, logistics parks and operator locations.

2\. Bulk Vehicle Rental / Fleet Onboarding

* Pitch the company's **vehicle rental / leasing / fleet deployment proposition** to fleet operators.
* Understand the operator's fleet size, vehicle type, utilization, financing status and deployment requirements.
* Drive **bulk vehicle onboarding** from initial discussion through documentation and activation.
* Coordinate vehicle inspection, documentation, verification, contract execution and deployment.
* Ensure committed vehicles are activated within agreed timelines.
* Work closely with operations, finance, fleet and service teams to resolve onboarding bottlenecks.

3\. Commercial Negotiation

* Negotiate rental rates, commercial terms, deposits, tenure, utilization commitments and other operator\-level commercials.
* Prepare commercial proposals and business cases for fleet owners.
* Understand fleet\-owner economics and identify mutually viable commercial structures.
* Ensure deals meet internal contribution\-margin and business requirements.
* Support contract closure and ensure commercial terms are correctly documented.

4\. Relationship \& Account Management

* Build long\-term relationships with SFOs and fleet operators.
* Act as the primary point of contact during onboarding and early deployment.
* Monitor fleet activation, utilization, availability and operator satisfaction.
* Identify opportunities to increase fleet size and expand relationships with existing operators.
* Resolve commercial and operational escalations in coordination with internal teams.

5\. Market Development

* Map the Bangalore fleet ecosystem and maintain a database of fleet owners and operators.
* Track competitor offerings, rental rates, incentives and market practices.
* Identify emerging fleet clusters and new demand pockets.
* Build referral and channel relationships with vehicle dealers, financiers, OEMs, logistics companies and fleet ecosystem partners.

6\. Reporting \& Performance Management

* Maintain an accurate sales pipeline and daily activity tracker.
* Track leads, meetings, proposals, negotiations, closures, vehicles committed and vehicles activated.
* Prepare weekly/monthly business development reports.
* Ensure achievement of monthly targets for:
* New SFOs acquired
* Vehicles onboarded
* Vehicles activated
* Fleet utilization
* Revenue contribution
* Conversion rate
* Operator retention

* **2–5 years of experience** in Business Development, B2B Sales, Fleet Sales, Vehicle Rental/Leasing, Logistics, Mobility or Last\-Mile Delivery.

* Candidates from other **EV, fleet rental, 3PL, transportation, logistics or commercial vehicle businesses** with similar experience are also encouraged to apply.

* Fleet\-owner / transporter acquisition
* Bulk vehicle onboarding

* Ability to work independently in the field

Adira is on a mission to make better innerwear accessible to women across every stage of life. From girls and teenagers to mothers, plus\-size women, and seniors, we design products around real\-life needs that are often ignored by the mainstream market.

As a pioneer in women's intimate wear innovation, Adira holds a patent for its period panty and has built a strong customer base through D2C and marketplaces. We are now entering an exciting next phase: taking Adira beyond online channels and building a strong offline and institutional presence across India and international markets.

This role is for someone who wants to build a new business channel from the ground up—not simply manage an existing sales territory.

**About the Role:**

We are looking for an experienced Offline Expansion \& Institutional Sales Manager to build Adira's offline distribution, institutional sales, B2B, and international B2B markets

You will be responsible for identifying and opening new opportunities across hospitals, schools, colleges, old\-age homes, NGOs, corporates, institutions, specialty retailers, distributors, and other relevant organizations, while also exploring international order opportunities through structured outbound sales.

A major part of this role will involve cold calling, cold emailing, prospecting, networking, business development, and relationship building to create a strong pipeline and convert opportunities into recurring business.

* Build and execute Adira's offline expansion and institutional sales strategy.
* Identify and develop new B2B and institutional opportunities across India and selected international markets.
* Generate leads through cold calling, cold emailing, LinkedIn outreach, networking, referrals, databases, exhibitions, and industry contacts.
* Develop institutional relationships with hospitals, schools, colleges, old\-age homes, NGOs, corporates, healthcare organizations, and other relevant institutions.
* Identify opportunities for Large\-Volume procurement of Adira products for institutional and organizational requirements.
* Develop relationships with retail outlets, specialty stores, distributors, and regional retail partners.
* Identify and onboard suitable offline distribution and retail partners.
* Build international B2B opportunities and generate Large\-Volume order enquiries from global markets.
* Own the complete sales cycle—from prospecting and first contact to negotiation, order closure, fulfilment coordination, and repeat business.
* Prepare proposals, quotations, presentations, product introductions, and commercial offers for institutional and B2B customers.
* Understand customer requirements and work with internal teams to recommend the right products, sizes, quantities, pricing, and commercial structures.
* Build a strong pipeline and maintain accurate records of prospects, opportunities, follow\-ups, and closures.

**Manager Capital Sales**

**What we do at Weir**  

We are a global leader in mining technology for a sustainable future. We help our customers extract the resources the world needs more efficiently and more sustainably. Our planet’s future depends on the transition to renewable energy, and that transition can only happen with the metals and minerals our customers deliver. So, we work side by side with mines across the globe to move less rock, use less energy, use water wisely, and create less waste. Together, we drive the shift to smart, efficient, and more sustainable mining.

**Make your impact**  

You’ll play a key role in solving real\-world challenges. You’ll apply your skills to deliver results that matter whether that’s through engineering, planning or customer support. You’ll work with purpose, learn every day and help shape a more sustainable future.

**What you’ll do**

* Sales Leadership: Drive capital equipment sales within the assigned region, focusing on Enduron High Pressure Grinding Rolls, Enduron Optimil, and integrated future\-ready flowsheet solutions. Lead marketing, sales, and strategic initiatives to expand market presence.
* Customer Relationship Management: Build and nurture strong multi\-level relationships with customers, engineering firms, consultants, contractors, and asset owners in the mining and minerals processing sectors. Act as the primary interface between customers and commercial teams locally and overseas.
* Market Analysis \& Business Development: Analyze market trends to identify new business opportunities and support quotation processes in collaboration with technical teams. Translate customer inquiries into viable technology solutions.
* Sales Cycle \& Contract Negotiations: Manage the sales cycle end\-to\-end, including contract negotiations, ensuring successful deal closures and market share growth.

**What you’ll bring**

**Must\-haves:**  

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Mining Engineering, or Mineral Processing.
* Minimum 5 years of sales experience, preferably in capital equipment or mining industry.
* Strong communication skills in English, both verbal and written.
* Proven ability to build customer relationships and secure deals with a goal\-oriented, persistent, and professional approach.
**Nice\-to\-haves:**  

* Background in mining or mineral processing industry.
* Experience with CRM and ERP systems.
* Ability to mentor and develop sales skills in a growing team environment.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze market trends and identify new business opportunities.
**Why join Weir?**  

We live our values — we think safety first, do the right thing, respect each other, aim high, and delight our customers. We encourage our people to lead by example and celebrate our successes.  

We’re passionate about our purpose to help deliver the natural resources that are essential to create a better future for the world. We do this by combining our deep customer insights, world\-class engineering, materials science expertise, and intelligent automation to deliver innovative end\-to\-end solutions incorporating our signature technologies.  

We believe your voice matters and your ideas make a difference. We’re working hard to nurture a diverse culture where our people feel like they belong and can do the best work of their lives. You can help shape our unique culture through our inclusion networks and safety initiatives.

Craft inspired. Textile curious. Design obsessed.

KabiraTex is looking for a curious and commercially minded person who understand or genuinely wants to explore the world of **artisan made textiles, Indian crafts, handlooms, weaves, prints and surface techniques**.

This is not a conventional sales role.

We are looking for someone who enjoys **researching interesting brands, designers, hotels, restaurants and spaces**, discovering the people behind them, and figuring out where artisan made and sustainable textiles could create value.

Our initial focus is the **B2B home furnishing, interior design and hospitality market**, particularly in Bengaluru.

* Share market insights with the KabiraTex team what designers are looking for, emerging applications, materials, trends and opportunities

You Could Be a Great Fit If You...

* Are genuinely interested in **artisan textiles, handloom, weaving, block printing, embroidery, natural materials or Indian craft**
* Enjoy discovering new brands, designers, hotels, cafes and interesting spaces
* Have a good visual/design sensibility
* Are naturally good at internet research and finding the right people
* Can communicate confidently and thoughtfully with designers, founders and businesses
* Are comfortable with cold research and reaching out to people you haven't met before
* Are organised enough to systematically track prospects and follow\-ups
* Are curious about **sustainability, responsible design and artisan livelihoods**

Background We're Open To

You could come from **Textile Design, Textile Technology, Fashion, Home Furnishing, Interior Design, Merchandising, Sourcing, Lifestyle Products, Hospitality, Business Development or a related field**.

Candidates from design/textile institutes with strong research and communication skills are welcome.

Prior B2B sales experience is useful, but **deep curiosity, initiative and an understanding of textiles/design are equally important**.

regular telemarketing/sales

We want someone who can ask:

Who would genuinely value this textile?  
Where could it be used?  
Who should we speak to?  
And how do we start that conversation?

If that sounds like the way you think, we'd like to hear from you.

**Apply with your CV and a short note telling us about an artisan textile, craft tradition, design brand or space that you find interesting and why.**
