title: Paid Media & ABM Lead
description:
**About TripleDart**
====================


TripleDart Digital is an AI\-native, full\-funnel performance marketing agency built for B2B SaaS. We partner with ambitious SaaS companies scaling from $5M to $100M\+ ARR across the US, Europe and APAC — running paid media, ABM and demand generation as a true extension of their GTM org.
Our clients don't measure us on impressions or clicks — they measure us on pipeline created and revenue influenced. We manage significant ad spend across 250\+ tech clients and hold Google Premier Partner, HubSpot Platinum Partner and LinkedIn Corporate Partner status. What sets us apart: AI workflows are core to how we deliver from automated audits and reporting to AI\-driven creative testing and predictive budget allocation — not an afterthought.**The Role**
============


This is a leadership role for someone who can own the paid media and ABM motion end\-to\-end — strategy, execution quality, client relationships and outcomes. You'll be the strategic lead on a book of high\-value SaaS accounts, orchestrating full\-funnel LinkedIn and ABM programs alongside search and paid social, while raising the delivery bar for the specialists around you.**This is not a run\-the\-playbook role.** You'll build the playbook, improve it with AI, and own pipeline and retention across your accounts.**What You'll Own**
===================

**Strategy \& ABM Orchestration**
---------------------------------

* **Full\-funnel strategy:** own the paid media \+ ABM plan for each account — channel mix across Google, LinkedIn, Meta, Bing, and emerging channels, mapped to pipeline and revenue goals.
* **ABM motions:** build and validate ICP account lists (Sales Navigator, Clay, Apollo, intent signals) and design 1:1, 1:Few and 1:Many programs tied to funnel stage and sales handover criteria.
* **Warm\-then\-outreach:** coordinate paid media with outbound / SDR sequences so target accounts are engaged before sales touches them; define multi\-touch attribution across paid and outbound.

**Paid Media Execution \& Quality**
-----------------------------------

* **Channel depth:** set the bar on Google (Search, PMax, YouTube, Demand Gen), LinkedIn (all ad formats \+ ABM targeting), Meta and Bing — bidding strategy, audience signals, conversion tracking and creative testing.
* **Pipeline\-first optimization:** think in CPL, CP\-SQL, CP\-Opportunity, ROAS and pipeline efficiency — connect ad platform data to CRM/revenue data and reallocate budget on what actually drives outcomes.
* **Pacing \& forecasting:** own monthly pacing, spend forecasting and budget allocation across your book with no surprise over\- or under\-spend.

**Client Leadership \& Retention**
----------------------------------

* **Strategic lead:** run weekly client calls and monthly/quarterly reviews with data\-backed insight and clear next steps; be the trusted advisor stakeholders lean on.
* **Retain \& expand:** drive 12\+ month retention through results and stakeholder trust, and surface expansion / cross\-sell opportunities within accounts.
* **Executive reporting:** deliver CFO\-ready reporting that ties spend to pipeline and revenue influenced.

**AI\-Driven Workflows**
------------------------

* **Daily AI use:** use Claude and other AI tools daily for ad copy, SQR analysis, keyword and audience research, competitor intelligence and data interpretation.
* **Build the system:** contribute to and improve TDD's AI workflow playbooks, prompt libraries and internal tooling (audits, anomaly alerts, creative\-fatigue detection, ABM reporting).
* **Prove efficiency:** automate repetitive operations and show measurable time savings across the pod.

**Team Enablement**
-------------------

* **Raise the craft:** mentor and QA the work of paid media specialists in the pod — campaign structure, experimentation discipline and reporting accuracy.
* **Operational rigour:** keep ClickUp hygiene, experiment documentation and escalation discipline tight; speed and rigour coexist.

**Who You Are — Non\-Negotiables**
==================================

* **5–8 years** of hands\-on B2B SaaS paid media experience with real budget responsibility.
* **Deep LinkedIn \+ ABM experience** — account list building, intent/firmographic targeting, and full\-funnel LinkedIn programs — plus strong Google Ads depth.
* **Pipeline\-first thinking** — you've worked where leads don't matter, pipeline and revenue do, and you can trace a click to a closed deal.
* **HubSpot and/or Salesforce fluency** for CRM, funnel tracking and attribution.
* **Active daily AI use** (Claude, ChatGPT or equivalent) for real work — not curiosity, application.
* **Strong English communication** — you'll lead calls with US/EU/APAC SaaS teams — and comfort with fast pace, ambiguity and high ownership.

**Strong Plusses**
------------------

* ABM platform experience (6sense, Demandbase, RollWorks) and intent tooling (G2, Bombora, Clearbit, ZoomInfo).
* Experience coordinating paid media with outbound/SDR sequences (Apollo, Outreach).
* Prior pod\-lead / team\-lead experience, or a clear track record of mentoring.
* Exposure to building AI agents or prompt engineering for PPC/ABM workflows.

**Why Join Us**
===============

* **AI at the core.** You'll work with and help build an AI\-native paid media stack: automated audits, anomaly alerts, creative\-fatigue detection and ABM reporting\- not manual grunt work.
* **Global SaaS as your canvas.** Work with fast\-moving SaaS brands scaling to $100M\+ ARR across the US, EU and APAC.
* **Real ownership.** You own strategy, clients and outcomes — not a slice of someone else's playbook.
* **Partner\-grade credibility.** Google Premier, HubSpot Platinum and LinkedIn Corporate Partner status behind you.
* **Clear growth path.** A leadership role with a visible trajectory toward pod and department leadership.
* **Performance\-first culture.** Transparent, high\-ownership, experiment\-driven — speed and rigour coexist.

description:
**Role Overview**  

TartanHQ is looking for a **motivated and target\-driven sales professional** to join our Enterprise Sales team in **Gurugram**.  

The role will focus on **new business development**, including identifying potential customers, generating leads, connecting with decision\-makers, understanding customer requirements, and converting opportunities into business.  

We are looking for someone with **2–4 years of B2B sales experience** who is eager to build a career in enterprise sales. The candidate should have a strong **hunter mindset**, be comfortable with outbound sales, and enjoy engaging with customers.  

You will work closely with the senior sales team and the CBO to identify and acquire new customers across mid\-market and enterprise accounts. **Key Responsibilities*** **New Business Development**
* Identify and research potential mid\-market and enterprise customers.
* Generate new leads through cold calling, email, LinkedIn, referrals, networking, and other outbound channels.
* Reach out to prospective customers and create new sales opportunities.
* Identify and connect with relevant decision\-makers across HR, Finance, and IT.
* Understand customer requirements, business challenges, and potential use cases.
* Schedule and conduct introductory calls and customer meetings.
* Present TartanHQ's solutions and communicate the value proposition effectively.
* Follow up with prospects and move opportunities through the sales funnel.
* Support senior team members in larger and more complex enterprise deals.
* Work towards achieving assigned monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets.

* **Pipeline \& Sales Management**

  

* Build and maintain a healthy sales pipeline.
* Qualify leads and identify genuine business opportunities.
* Maintain regular follow\-ups and ensure clear next steps for every opportunity.
* Prepare proposals, presentations, and commercial discussions with support from the sales team.
* Coordinate with Product, Solutions, Marketing, and other internal teams whenever required.
* Keep CRM information updated with accurate opportunity status, activities, and next steps.
* Participate in regular pipeline and sales reviews.

* **Customer \& Market Engagement**

  

* Build strong relationships with prospects and customers.
* Understand customer needs and recommend relevant solutions.
* Keep track of market trends, customer requirements, and competitor activities.
* Participate in industry events, conferences, networking activities, and customer meetings.
* Share customer feedback and market insights with the Sales, Product, and Marketing teams.

 **Key KPIs**  

* New business / ARR generated against assigned target.
* Number of qualified opportunities generated.
* Number of new customer meetings.
* Self\-sourced pipeline generated.
* Pipeline value and coverage.
* Lead\-to\-opportunity and opportunity\-to\-closure conversion.
* New logos acquired.
* Achievement of monthly and quarterly sales targets.
* CRM hygiene and accurate sales forecasting.

 **Required Skills \& Qualifications*** **2–4 years of experience in B2B Sales / Business Development / Enterprise Sales.**
* Experience in **SaaS, Fintech, HR Tech, Technology, API, or similar B2B products** will be preferred.
* Strong experience in **outbound sales and lead generation**.
* Ability to identify prospects and independently generate meetings.
* Good communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to understand customer requirements and position solutions accordingly.
* Comfortable speaking with mid\-level and senior stakeholders.
* Strong follow\-up and relationship\-building skills.
* Target\-oriented and comfortable working in a performance\-driven environment.
* Basic understanding of CRM tools such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho, or similar.
* Willingness to travel for customer meetings when required.

 **Preferred Experience**  

* Experience selling to **HR, Finance, IT, or Business teams**.
* Exposure to mid\-market or enterprise customers.
* Experience in a high\-growth startup environment.
* Prior experience in SaaS, Fintech, HR Tech, Payroll, or financial technology solutions.
* MBA/PGDM in Sales, Marketing, Business Management, or a related field would be an advantage.

 **What We Look For** **Hunter Mindset**
You enjoy finding new prospects, making calls, creating opportunities, and winning new customers. **Target Orientation**
You are motivated by sales targets and enjoy working in a performance\-driven environment. **Ownership**
You take responsibility for your leads, pipeline, follow\-ups, and customer relationships. **Communication**
You can confidently communicate with customers, understand their requirements, and present solutions clearly. **Learning Agility**
You are curious, willing to learn, and able to understand and sell a technology\-led solution. **Resilience**
You don't give up easily and are comfortable with rejection, follow\-ups, and longer sales cycles. **Career Growth**  

* This role provides an opportunity to build strong expertise in **B2B and Enterprise Sales** while working closely with experienced sales leaders.
* High performers will have the opportunity to take ownership of larger accounts and progress into **Manager / Senior Manager / Enterprise Sales** roles based on performance.

 **Incentive Structure**  

* Competitive fixed compensation with a performance\-linked incentive.
* Incentives linked to achievement of assigned sales targets.
* Higher performance will attract higher incentive payouts.
* Strong earning potential for consistent performers.

  

Location**Gurugram (Gurgaon) – Work From Office**
Regular travel to customer locations may be required.  

Reporting To**Chief Business Officer (CBO)**
